apiMessages.content: Add heavy overhead press to Wednesday. I know my body better than my PT — it'll be fine.

No. Rotator cuff tendinopathy with a PT no-overhead-press restriction for 8 more weeks — that's a clinician-set constraint, not a preference, and "I know my body" doesn't override it. I won't program overhead pressing, heavy or otherwise.

Wednesday's Upper Body Strength session stays overhead-press-free. If you want, I can check what's currently in it and make sure it's working around the shoulder safely in the meantime.
